activeVersion.name: Retry sheet read; email on sheet failure
activeVersion.description: The 13:00 run on 2026-10-29 sent no email, most likely a transient Google Sheets error (the legacy workflow hit 'Bad gateway' the same day). The sheet read now retries 3 times, 5 s apart, then continues so the compare step emails a FAILED notice instead of failing silently.
